data.title: Clobetasol + Salicylic acid
data.summary: IV Topical corticosteroids · Combination: super-potent steroid (clobetasol 0.05%) + keratolytic (salicylic acid 3–6%)
data.body:
_Topicals · IV Topical corticosteroids_

**Class:** Combination: super-potent steroid (clobetasol 0.05%) + keratolytic (salicylic acid 3–6%)

## Mechanism of action
- Salicylic acid removes scale (desmolytic), allowing better steroid penetration

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Thick plaque and scalp psoriasis (lotion/ointment), palmoplantar psoriasis, hyperkeratotic hand eczema, lichen simplex chronicus

## Dose & formulations
- Once or twice daily for up to 2 weeks; maximum 50 g/week; then switch to a maintenance regimen

## Adverse effects
- Steroid atrophy, striae, HPA suppression; salicylic acid irritation; salicylism over large areas

## Contraindications
- Face, flexures, genitals, children; large areas; infection

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid large areas.

## Viva points
- Same principle as halobetasol + SA
- Avoid on more than about 20% of body surface (salicylism and steroid absorption)

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.45 and ch.55; Khopkar ch.22. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
